summary.text: Greg Hembree is a Republican member of the South Carolina Senate for District 28 in Horry County, serving since 2013.
He is an attorney and chairs the Senate Education Committee.

paragraphs.text: Hembree was born on August 21, 1960, in Fort Leonard Wood, Missouri.
His official page lists a B.B.A. from the University of Memphis in 1982 and a J.D. from the University of South Carolina in 1985.
He served as North Myrtle Beach city attorney from 1995 to 1999 and as the 15th Circuit solicitor from 1999 to 2012.
He represented South Carolina at the National District Attorneys Association from 2009 to 2012.
He has served in the Senate since 2013, and his committees are Corrections and Penology, Education (chairman), Finance, Rules and Transportation.
He is married with three children and is an elder at Ocean Drive Presbyterian Church.
